history.dynasty: Chauhan dynasty of Patna (Patnagarh) - King Baijal Singh Dev
history.period: Early 15th century CE (some sources say 1313 AD - verify)
history.summary: Situated at the foothills of the Gandhamardhan hills near Paikmal; foundation laid by King Baijal Singh Dev (Baijal Dev) of Patna (Patnagarh) in the early 15th century CE, built in Kalinga/Orissan Deula style, ~45 feet tall, with sanctum and Jagamohana (three gates, each on four pillars). DATE CONFLICT: Bargarh district sources and some local accounts date the foundation to 1313 AD - treat as (verify). Legend from the Odia Kavya 'Nrusingha Charitra' (Jamuna Kandhuni, ~600 years ago): Vishnu as Marjara Keshari (cat-form Narasimha) confronted the Musika Daitya (mouse demon) and has guarded the region since. The Gandhamardan area was a centre of Buddhist scriptural learning in the time of the Chinese traveller Huen Tsang (Xuanzang). Nearby Gandhamardan hills hold ~22 natural springs and Kapil Dhar/Bhim Dhar waterfalls (attraction details lightly sourced).

name: Nrusinghanath Temple
town_description: Paikmal is a small town in Bargarh district of western Odisha, near the Odisha-Chhattisgarh border at the base of the Gandhamardhan hills. It is the access point for the Nrusinghanath Temple and the forested Gandhamardan range, known for medicinal plants, natural springs and waterfalls. The town sits roughly 110 km west of Bargarh town.
